title: Haarmeyer Wine Cellars Dinner at Supergeil
description:
Join us at Supergeil on October 21st for an intimate evening with Craig Haarmeyer from Haarmeyer Wine Cellars.


This one-night-only wine dinner will pair a thoughtfully curated multi-course menu with wines from Haarmeyer Wine Cellars, offering guests the opportunity to experience the wines alongside the people and stories behind them.

Tickets: $175 per person with wine pairing and $125 without.


Limited to 44 guests. Space is extremely limited, so we encourage you to reserve your seat early.
